# Aide-mémoires {#sec-aide-memoire}

## Manipulation de données (dplyr / tidyr)

```r
df |>
  filter(condition) |>
  select(col1, col2) |>
  mutate(nouvelle = col1 * 2) |>
  arrange(desc(nouvelle)) |>
  group_by(categorie) |>
  summarise(n = n(), moy = mean(nouvelle), .groups = "drop")

left_join(a, b, by = "id")
pivot_longer(df, cols = -id, names_to = "nom", values_to = "val")
pivot_wider(df, names_from = nom, values_from = val)
```

## Import / export

```r
readr::read_csv("data/fichier.csv")
readxl::read_excel("data/fichier.xlsx", sheet = 1)
readr::write_csv(df, "outputs/sortie.csv")
```

## ggplot2

```r
ggplot(df, aes(x, y, color = g)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  facet_wrap(~g) +
  labs(title = "...", x = "...", y = "...") +
  theme_minimal()

# Barres / hist / box
geom_col() ; geom_bar() ; geom_histogram(bins = 20) ; geom_boxplot()
ggsave("outputs/fig.png", width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 150)
```

## Statistiques

```r
summary(x); mean(x, na.rm = TRUE); median(x); sd(x); quantile(x)
table(x); prop.table(table(x))
cor(x, y); cor.test(x, y)
t.test(y ~ g, data = df)
mod <- lm(y ~ x1 + x2, data = df)
summary(mod); broom::tidy(mod); broom::augment(mod)
```

## Quarto (CLI)

```bash
quarto preview
quarto render --to html
quarto render --to pdf
quarto render --to docx
quarto check
```

## Shiny (minimal)

```r
ui <- fluidPage(selectInput("v", "Var", names(mtcars)), plotOutput("p"))
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$p <- renderPlot({ hist(mtcars[[input$v]]) })
}
shinyApp(ui, server)
```

## stringr / lubridate (extraits)

```r
str_detect(x, "abc"); str_replace_all(x, " ", "_"); str_to_lower(x)
ymd("2023-01-15"); year(d); month(d); floor_date(d, "month")
```
